name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; Indonesia troop deployment
summary: Indonesia deploys 21,000 troops in Jakarta after generals' arrest; Democrats win US Congress
state: Indonesian police detained three senior police generals, including the president's chief of staff, over alleged wiretapping of President Prabowo, and the military is deploying about 21,000 personnel to Jakarta; officials call it routine (AP via ABC News, 4 Nov). Democrats won both chambers in the 3 Nov US midterms, an uncontested result (Time). No G20 government had fallen and no coup was reported as of 4 Nov.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice for Indonesia and France before travelling; large deployments or strikes can disrupt transport.
rubric_hit: No G20 government collapse, contested election or coup = Normal

sources.title: ABC News (AP) — Indonesia deploys troops to boost Jakarta's security after generals' arrest
Time — Democrats win control of House and Senate

why: Coups, contested elections and constitutional crises in large economies unsettle markets, alliances and policy.
drivers: Elections, government collapses, coups, emergency rule, mass protest movements.

rubric.alert: Coup or constitutional crisis in a G20 country, or deadly unrest threatening a G20 government.
rubric.watch: Government collapse or contested election in a G20 country, or a coup anywhere.
rubric.normal: No G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month.
